description: Grid Supply Point Connection Information is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Grid Supply Point Connection Information dataset contains information on each GSP in our region, including proposed new sites, on various connection information. This includes connected capacity to date, transmission reinforcement dates, and technical limit information If you are unsure of any of the column meanings, please hover over the column heading for a description. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Connecting Generation, Network. Its keywords are Connections, Extra High Voltage (EHV), Generation, EHV Substation Data. The portal shows 2026-02-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
